firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a magnificent landscape goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Point the central board’s arrow toward the starting player.
This starting criterion applies to the multiplayer game. The solo variant has its own setup.
